Introduction

Seolhee is a South Korean singer-songwriter and producer under Bean Entertainment and CodeM Entertainment. She is a member of 1159CINDERELLA, the project girl group Ikling, as well as a former member of the indie duo "Premonition of Dawn", girl group "Girls2000", and female duo "soavil.mp3". She originally debuted as a soloist under the stage name Ancer on January 26, 2018 with the digital single "About Me". She re-debuted under her current name on January 4, 2020 with the single "Hide and Seek". She was a contestant in the jihadol survival program Girls Frontier.
